verdict.rationale: Discord is a voice and chat communication platform, so AI-generated meeting or call recaps are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party AI notes, transcription or recap feature for voice calls. The bot, Gateway and Social SDK voice features are only developer building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
